Create a production-ready original 4-column by 2-row transparent eight-direction RTS sprite atlas of ONE consistent six-wheeled armored mobile air-defense truck. Row 1: E (nose right), NE (nose upper-right, see the truck's rear and right flank), N (nose away/up, see rear bumper, NOT front grille), NW (nose upper-left, rear and left flank). Row 2: W (nose left), SW (nose lower-left, see front grille and right flank), S (nose down/towards viewer, front grille and windshield), SE (nose lower-right, front grille and left flank). No repeated north/south or front/rear views. Keep each complete radar, all missile tips, antenna and tires fully inside its own cell with generous true transparent margins on all sides, about 12 percent. Vehicle centers match reference 2 cell centers, no clipping or overlap. No floor or cast shadow, no ground, no water, no exhaust or effects, no backdrop, no labels, no numbers, no text, no logos, no flag, no green fringe, no glow, no grid lines. Genuine transparent RGBA background. This is the actual game sprite atlas, not a concept presentation or collage.
